WS_CLIENT_DATA
Description
When the system collects the specified amount of data via the
WS::collect command, WS_CLIENT_DATA event is raised. Within the
context of this event, the collected payload can then be accessed
using the WS::payload command.
Change Log
@BIGIP-12.1 –First introduced the event.
